deploy-bot: Deploy v2.14.3 -> green completed in eu-west-1 with weight=30%.

deploy-bot: Canary health check reported a 5m error-rate spike on /generate (~12% -> 18%). rolling... logs: https://internal.logs/redeem/2198765432

Mike (oncall): paging - seeing 5xx surge, grabbing logs.

Sanjay R.: 502s + high p99 latency (600ms-2s) coming from green nodes only. blue is OK.

Lucy W.: Confirmed: control-plane shows weight=30/70 blue->green, but eu-central route table still points 100% to green IPs — TTL might be sticking.

Mike (oncall): Enterprise customers reporting timeouts. marking P0 and creating incident.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 created · P0 · oncall: Mike (oncall)

Janet H.: Recommend kill-switch for green swap: `feature.green_swap = false` — will force routing back to blue.

Sanjay R.: Applying flag now:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/flags/green_swap -d '{"value":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

deploy-bot: Flag change accepted (200). Propagating to edge (~<90s expected).

Mike (oncall): Metrics dropping in eu-west, but eu-central still elevated — looks like DNS cache + long TTLs holding green IPs.

Lucy W.: Running edge purge for eu-central:
`edgectl purge --zone eu-central --selector route=green` -> task abc123

infra-bot: Purge task abc123 completed in 18s.

Mike (oncall): Error rate down to baseline across regions. customers confirming recovery :thumbsup:.

Janet H.: Initial RCA hypothesis: rollout automation updated weights in control-plane but route-propagation job to eu-central failed with 504s, leaving inconsistent routing + warmup steps skipped for KV caches on green.

Sanjay R.: I'll queue a targeted rollback of green in eu-central and run a focused canary with traffic shadowed from blue to validate warmups.

Janet H.: Followups: add better deploy chokepoint (wait-for-route-ack) + shorter temporary TTL during weight changes + alert on route-table drift.

Mike (oncall): Handoff notes posted to INC-2026-045. Handoff to @Sanjay R. in 45m — leaving monitoring links and runbook steps.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 status: resolved · closed by Mike (oncall) · duration ~12m
